scene.ko: 의사에게 항생제 먹는 법을 듣고 확인하다가, 그 약이 보험이 안 된다는 것을 알고 보험이 되는 약으로 바꾸고 다음 진료도 잡는다.

lines.en: Your test results show a sinus infection, so I'm going to prescribe an antibiotic.
lines.ko: 검사 결과 축농증이 있어서 항생제를 처방해 드릴게요.

lines.en: Okay. Could you tell me how I should take it?
lines.ko: 네. 어떻게 먹어야 하는지 알려 주시겠어요?
alt: Okay. How should I take it?
All right. Can you explain how to take it?

lines.en: Take one pill twice a day, with food, for ten days. Make sure you finish all of it, even if you feel better.
lines.ko: 하루 두 번 식사와 함께 한 알씩 열흘 동안 드세요. 나아진 것 같아도 꼭 끝까지 다 드셔야 해요.

lines.en: So, one pill in the morning and one in the evening, until it's all gone?
lines.ko: 그러니까 아침에 한 알, 저녁에 한 알, 다 먹을 때까지요?
alt: So, one in the morning and one at night until I finish it?
Just to check: one pill every morning and evening until they're gone?

lines.en: Exactly. Do you have any other questions?
Yes. Do you know if my insurance will cover it? I'm on a Greenleaf Health plan.
lines.ko: 네. 제 보험으로 처리가 되는지 아세요? 그린리프 헬스 보험이에요.
alt: Yes. Will my insurance pay for it? My plan is Greenleaf Health.
Just one. Is this covered by my insurance? I have Greenleaf Health.

lines.en: Let me check... I'm afraid your plan doesn't cover this one. It could cost you around $90.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요... 죄송하지만 이 약은 보험이 안 되네요. 90달러쯤 나올 수 있어요.

lines.en: That's quite expensive. Is there a generic version or something similar that's covered?
lines.ko: 꽤 비싸네요. 복제약이나 보험이 되는 비슷한 약이 있을까요?
alt: That's a lot. Is there a cheaper generic that my insurance covers?
Hmm, that's expensive. Could you prescribe something similar that's covered?

lines.en: Yes, there's a generic version that works just as well. With your insurance, it should only be about $10. I'd also like to see you again in two weeks.
lines.ko: 네, 효과가 똑같은 복제약이 있어요. 보험을 적용하면 10달러 정도밖에 안 할 거예요. 그리고 2주 뒤에 한 번 더 뵐게요.

lines.en: That's much better, thank you. I'll book a follow-up appointment at the front desk on my way out.
lines.ko: 훨씬 낫네요, 감사합니다. 나가면서 접수처에서 다음 진료 예약을 할게요.
alt: Great, thanks. I'll book the follow-up at the front desk.
Thank you, that helps a lot. I'll schedule my next visit at the front desk.

expressions.en: Could you tell me how I should ___?

expressions.note: once 한 번 · three times 세 번

expressions.en: Do you know if my insurance will cover ___?
